form.name: Form 1, Application for Permit to Drill, Re-enter/Deepen, or Renew/Extend (APD)
form.notes: Read the blank form (sheet 'APD', form dated March 2016, in the agency's WOGCC Forms workbook last modified 24 Jul 2026) and its page-3 instructions. Companion forms: 1A split estate, 1B electrical, 1C baseline water, 14B pit. Filed through the Wyoming eForm (login); the eForm manual could not be fetched. The 2-page paper form is numbered to match the BLM 3160-3. Fee $500 per Form 1.

api_number.n: Api_Number in the approved-permits export; APINO in the well header. WOGCC assigns it (Form 1 block 9)

permit_number.n: Form 1 has no permit-number box: the API number is the permit key (blank at filing, WOGCC assigns it)

well_name.n: Well_NO (export) / WN (header); Form 1 block 8; horizontal names end in H

lease_name.n: Unit_Lease column; Form 1 block 7 asks unit name/number for committed lands only

operator_name.n: Company column (export and header); Form 1 block 2

operator_id.n: Form 1 asks the operator name only; the Form 23 registration code is not a column in the exports seen

operator_type.n: No business-type box on Form 1; none in the exports

bond.n: Form 1 box 20 Type of Bond and No.; not a column in any export seen

district.n: No district on Form 1. BASIN in the well header is a geologic basin, not an agency office

field_pool.n: Field column (export) / FIELD_NAME (header); Form 1 block 10 and Reservoir(s)

surface_latlon.n: Latitude and Longitude columns; Form 1 asks SHL lat/long NAD83

surface_plss.n: Qtr1, Qtr2, Lot_Tract, Section, Township, Range, Foot1, Foot2

bottom_hole_loc.n: BFoot1/2, BSec, BQtr1/2, BTwp, BRge, Blat, Blon; Form 1 block 4 asks BHL and top productive interval

lateral_path.n: Form 1 attachment box Directional/Horizontal Plan; survey upload through WYSTAR; not published as data

elevation.n: Elevation (ground) and Elev_KB columns; Form 1 asks ungraded and graded elevation

surface_owner.n: Form 1 Surface Ownership Fee/State/Fed and Split Estate Yes/No, Form 1A; not a column (LAND_TYPE code undecoded)

well_type.n: Well_Class code (O, G, I, D, MW, ST...); the export also filters by oil/gas, coal bed, injector/disposal

work_type.n: Form 1 box: Drill / Re-enter-Deepen / Renew-or-extend. No work-type column in the export (checked all 48)

well_direction.n: Dir/Hor column (export), HORIZ_DIR (header); Form 1 Directional/Horizontal/Natural Drift boxes

proposed_depth_md.n: TD column on a permit with no Comp_Date (7701, 10605 ft) reads as planned depth; not documented. Form 1 box 19 MD

proposed_depth_tvd.n: Form 1 box 19 asks TVD beside MD; the files carry TD and MD but no TVD column

lateral_length.n: Not a Form 1 box; the separate horizontal-well application (sample on Download menu) was not read

target_formation.n: Bot_Form column (export) / BOTFORM (header); Form 1 Reservoir(s) and Top Productive Interval

formation_tops.n: Rule 3-8(c)(v) asks estimated depths of markers and objective horizons; not a Form 1 box; not in data

casing_program.n: Form 1 table: hole size, casing size, lb/ft, API grade, new/used, centralizers, depth (MD)

cement_program.n: Form 1 table: sacks of API cement and cement class; Rule 3-8(c)(viii) adds additives, density, excess

pressure_control.n: Form 1 attachment box Drilling & BOP Plans; space 23 must include a blowout prevention plan

h2s.n: Form 1 mentions H2S only as an injection/disposal type under Other; no H2S plan box seen; plans not read

pit_waste.n: Separate Form 14B (pit) must accompany APDs on State or Fee minerals unless no pit and cuttings are hauled

water.n: Form 1C baseline water wells must accompany the APD; setback-from-water question; Rule 3-8(c)(iii) and (ix)

fracture_plan.n: Form 1 box Stimulation Completion Plan; stimulation must be approved on Form 1, Form 4 or a fieldwide plan

frac_dates.n: Treatment Data Download has a treatment day, month and year; one date per treatment, no start and end

frac_chemicals.n: Scanned frac disclosure with CAS numbers is in a well's Sundries; no bulk file lists chemicals

frac_additives.n: Scanned disclosure lists trade name, supplier and purpose; reached from the well's Sundries page

frac_amounts.n: Scanned disclosure gives percent and pounds per ingredient; bulk file has only total volume and proppant

spacing_unit.n: Form 1 boxes: Well Spacing, conforms to Ch.3 Sec.2, 17 Spacing Docket #; no docket column in the export

spacing_exception.n: Form 1: is this an exception location (attach approval); separate $75 exception application

mineral_owner.n: MineralCode (numeric, key not found) and Lease_No (e.g. a federal lease no.) columns; Form 1 box 16 Fee/State/Fed

fee.n: Form 1 note: $500 fee with each Form 1 (WOGCC Forms workbook, July 2026); not published per well

notice_hearing.n: Form 1 Split Estate box and Form 1A; Rule 3-8(f) certified-mail notice for horizontals; no per-well link seen

date_received.n: Rcvd.Date column in the approved export (yyyymmdd); RECDATE in the header looks like the same date

date_approved.n: Approved column (yyyymmdd) in the DumpByApdA export; Form 1 page 2 holds the Approval Date

date_expires.n: Fixed by Rule 3-8(h): two years after issuance; no expiry-date field on Form 1 or in the exports

spud_date.n: Spud_Date column (export, mm/dd/yyyy); FIRSTSPUD in the header

completion_date.n: Comp_Date column (export); FIRSTCOMP in the header

status.n: Status and Status_Dte columns (codes DP, AP, PO, PG, PA, EP...)

plat_image.n: Survey plat required with every APD (Form 1 checkbox); whether scans are online was not verified

logs.n: pipeline.wyo.gov has Logs and Cores menus; not opened

grade_reason: Free, no login, reachable (200). The approved-permits export returns one row per permit/well with an Approved date (yyyymmdd), a received date, well class, horizontal flag, location and spud date, by any date range. Strictly it has no work-type column, so counts mix new drills with re-entries, deepenings and renewals (a B under a strict reading of the rubric).
producer_plan: Use the WOGCC approved-permits export (POST https://pipeline.wyo.gov/DumpByApdA.cfm with bmon,bday,byear,emon,eday,eyear and cType: 1 all permitted, 2 oil and gas, 3 coal bed, 4 injector/disposal, 5 horizontal, 9 waiting on approval). One request per month (or one per week for the nightly) returns an .xls that is really an HTML table: parse it with the standard library, header row first, one data row per permit. Month = the Approved column (yyyymmdd). Count rows per month per Well_Class (codes seen in the well header: O, G, GO, OO oil and gas; I and D injection or disposal; MW, ST, M monitor and test; coal bed wells are asked for separately with cType 3 and carry old numeric classes such as 05, so decide whether to include them). Dir/Hor 'H' marks horizontals (seen in the sample); a drilled-but-not-yet-spud permit has a blank Spud_Date. Cross-check with the monthly well-header zip (RECDATE received counts, FIRSTSPUD, STATUS). Caveats: no work-type field, so new, re-entry, deepen and renew cannot be split (renewals keep the API number, so the same API could appear in two months); the source says scraping is not allowed, so use the sanctioned Down Load pages sparingly (one request per run, a pause between, never loop); dates come in two formats; whether a revised permit rewrites Approved is not known.
privacy_notes: Company column holds operator names (some may be individuals; apply the tracker's corporation/LLC/LP rule before naming one). The exports carry no phone, e-mail or street address. Form 1 itself collects a contact person, phone and e-mail, and the surface owner's details go on Form 1A; none of that is in the data files. Nothing copied.
